title: MoQT Trace Corpus Manifest
description: Machine-readable index of the .moqtrace conformance corpus: every case, the files it holds, and what a conformant reader must find in them.

spec.description: Which format the cases are in.

description.description: What the corpus is and what it claims.

id.description: Directory name under moqtrace/, and the case's contract with consumers.

description.description: What the case is for, and why the corpus would be weaker without it.

version.description: Format version the file declares in its preamble.

segments.description: How many segments the file concatenates.

truncated.description: Whether the file stops mid-event, which a reader must report distinctly.

protocol.description: Header protocol identifier, verbatim — not necessarily one this revision names.

perspective.description: Header perspective, verbatim — not necessarily one this revision names.

eventTypes.description: Event discriminant, as a decimal string, to the number of events carrying it. Types no revision defines appear under their own number.

name.description: File name inside the case directory.

writer.description: What wrote it. Files of one case carry the same content from different encoders.

bytes.description: Size on disk. The corpus is byte-exact, so this is checked.
